sentences.text:
Smt. Mani Adhikari vs Sri Suman Ghosh And Others on 14
September, 2023
 Page 1 of 1

High Court Of Tripura
 Agartala
 Mac App. No.88 of 2023

Smt. Mani Adhikari
 
 Versus
Sri Suman Ghosh and others

.. 
For Appellant(s) : Mr. D. Debnath, Advocate.
Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Mr. Aparesh Kumar Singh Order 14/09/2023

The claimants
have approached this Court in appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 for
enhancement of compensation against the judgment and award dated 05/06/2023 passed by Ld.
Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.1, West Tripura, Agartala, in case No. T.S. (Mac) 48
of 2020.
Issue notice through speed post upon all the respondents and, additionally, under ordinary process on respondents No.1 and 3 for which requisites be filed within one week.

(APARESH KUMAR SINGH), CJ Munna S MUNNA SAHA Digitally signed by MUNNA SAHA Date:
2023.09.15 13:01:04 +05'30'
